record: ICRA claim separation: what 2v2 results prove vs what SP-PPO must prove
deadline: ICRA 2027 contributed papers 2026-09-15; 8 pages incl. refs
LEAD_WITH: We demonstrate that a strategy-conditioned multi-robot PPO controller can represent distinct, payoff-relevant latent strategies and systematically characterize how progressive parameter sharing affects their preservation.
DO_NOT_LEAD_WITH: We created a new PPO that allows latent strategies / SP-PPO preserves latent strategies better than PPO alone.

supported_by: Share-Encoder latent closed-loop X-pattern (RUNG1_LADDER_EVAL_RESULT OWN_GATE PASS)
sharing ladder Share-0 -> Encoder -> Backbone -> Macro (RUNG0..3)
measurement hierarchy: imitation/JS can remain strong while gate fails (Share-Macro)
proves: Discrete z modes in pi_theta(a|o,z) can express payoff-relevant specialization (z0 advantageous on A, z1 on B).
Shared perception (Share-Encoder) is tolerated with no detectable paired loss vs Share-0.
Sharing the backbone begins statistically detectable Pole-A degradation while absolute gate may still PASS.
Sharing macro outputs breaks the joint specialization gate (Delta_A LCB = 0).
does_NOT_prove: That CSC caused the latent modes.
That SPFT caused the latent modes.
That SP-PPO (PPO+CSC+SPFT) preserves specialization better than matched PPO alone.
CLAIM_A_architecture_and_sharing.flagship_sentence: In 2v2, payoff-relevant strategy specialization is preserved under shared perception, begins to degrade when the policy backbone is shared, and fails once macro-action outputs are also shared.

CLAIM_B_algorithmic_SP_PPO.required_evidence: Matched controlled comparison measuring the same Delta_A/Delta_B crossover gate (and preferably retention + behavior): PPO vs PPO+CSC vs PPO+CSC+SPFT.

sealed_status_in_methodology_results.CSC_vs_PPO_only: NEITHER satisfies specialization criterion; paired treatment-minus-control does not clear zero. CSC does NOT recover payoff-level specialization under frozen protocol.
sealed_status_in_methodology_results.SPFT_vs_CSC_only: NEITHER satisfies specialization criterion; paired contrasts do not clear zero. SPFT does NOT establish recovery relative to CSC alone.

CLAIM_B_algorithmic_SP_PPO.spppo_v1_program_status: CLOSED as valid FAIL (SPPPO_DIAGNOSTIC_ARC_CLOSEOUT / SPPPO_V1_NOT_CONFIRMED). Do not reopen as automatic success from sharing-ladder results.
CLAIM_B_algorithmic_SP_PPO.how_to_report_in_paper: Report CSC/SPFT as the proposed intervention family for retention during continued PPO, with sealed negative / non-recovery results if that is what is on disk. Do not attribute Share-Encoder PASS to SP-PPO.
CLAIM_B_algorithmic_SP_PPO.visual_point: None of the three arms recovers the specialization gate; Share-Encoder PASS is architectural, not SP-PPO credit.
